Results.ReviewText: Assembly was simple and straightforward.  Quality of design and materials is obvious.  This grill is a perfect size for up to eight people for most BBQ fare.  I like that the ignition is built into the burner controls, and the searing feature is a plus.  The grills are heavy duty and simple to clean. Some might miss having a side burner, but we rarely used a side burner in the past, and enjoy having a usable work surface on both sides.
Results.Title: Great Quality BBQ Grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve always used Weber grills due to their quality build. I like the Spirit grill we recently purchased but after getting it home I noticed the back side was entirely open with no panel being installed. This opens it up to rain, wildlife and other weather elements. I reached out to Weber and they told me this was their new design and no back cover came with the Spirit E-325. Overall, a good grill but it seems they are implementing cost cutting measures by eliminating these covers and I probably wouldn’t have purchased it if I had known it ahead of time. Just didn’t do my homework.
Results.Title: Weber E-325 Review

Results.ReviewText: Good quality grill with lots of accessories, sear option is a bonus, grill heats up quickly, grease retrieval  system is very easy to use and accessible.  Several years ago this grill had four wheels to make movement easy, this set the grill apart from others, now it has two wheels that limits easy movement, which I think lowered your standards, also a door on the back would be nice, preventing animals from entering.  If Weber is the King of Grills, then maintain your high standards
Results.Title: Grill Master

Results.ReviewText: This is replacing a Costco bbq I had for 20 years.  I love the size with the collapsing side trays.  It heats quickly and evenly.  I bought a cover for the grill and it works great.  Here’s the problem I didn’t have with previous bbqs.  Way too may openings for mice.  Within 2 days, mice set up for a cozy nest in the pan below the grill.  I don’t have mouse issues in my house or garage but they love my new Weber grill.  My wife saw me cleaning out the mice and she is reluctant to have any food prepared on the grill.
Results.Title: Mice Love my New Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I've been in front of a barbece grill since I was a kid - more than 60 years ago.  Charcoal.  Wood chips.  Open flame.  Propane.  I've used them all.  

All these years, I've had my eye on the prize.  After bonus at work,  it finally arrived.  A Weber E-325.  Sure, it's not the biggest BBQ.  Weber makes much bigger.  But this little masterpiece is perfect for the 2 of us and a few friends.

The heat is controllable all across the grill.  It will sear a steak or chicken and sing quiet flame songs to something bubbling and delicious.

For the first time the temperature gauge on the outside matches the one I put on the inside!

Many thanks to Weber and to Ace Hardware (who assembled and delivered my grill flawlessly).
Results.Title: Finally.  The Best.
